why: The second npm variant of November 2026 inserts its var z tag as lines of their own, with no padding and a tag that is not a number ('-II', '-%', '-E', '-1234567890'), followed by the six-number NX table. The 3.0.1 pattern needs the padding and digits, so these files came back clean; the 2026-11-16 review found the form in eight injected files across six npm releases. Inside node_modules the release itself is the indicator; this case is a copy outside it, in a vendored folder and a build output, as both table spellings, since which one the files use is not established.
